scripts.requests: npx wrangler d1 execute pocketchomp-requests --remote --command "SELECT created_at, text FROM food_requests ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30"
scripts.requests:top: npx wrangler d1 execute pocketchomp-requests --remote --command "SELECT lower(text) AS request, count(*) AS n, max(created_at) AS latest FROM food_requests GROUP BY lower(text) ORDER BY n DESC, latest DESC LIMIT 30"
scripts.requests:migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply pocketchomp-requests --remote
